    10	# Fix MSE Cards
    11	
    12	MSE edits = provisional source. Preserve unless review marks user error.
    13	
    14	## Non-negotiable flow
    15	
    16	1. Scope dirty MSE files.
    17	2. Analyze diffs vs rules.
    18	3. Resolve semantic/card conflicts in one `.tmp/*.html`; stop.
    19	4. Reconcile MSE + consumers.
    20	5. Resolve all rule proposals in one `.tmp/*.html`; stop.
    21	6. Call `update-rules`; apply decisions; write final ADR.
    22	7. Verify lint/tests/export.
    23	
    24	No decision questions in chat. No `AskUserQuestion`. Every question/proposal series → HTML. Final ADR may use Markdown: resolved record, no questions.
    25	
    26	## HTML review contract
    27	
    28	Path:
    29	
    30	```text
    31	.tmp/fix-mse-cards/YYYY-MM-DD-<project-slug>-card-conflicts.html
    32	.tmp/fix-mse-cards/YYYY-MM-DD-<project-slug>-rule-proposals.html
    33	```
    34	
    35	One file per gate/run. Self-contained HTML5: UTF-8, viewport, semantic markup, inline CSS/JS, no remote deps. Dark default; `prefers-color-scheme` light support. Responsive + printable. High readability: sticky summary/nav, progress, grouped decision cards, evidence tables, before/after diffs, concrete examples, impact badges. Use inline SVG/CSS diagrams only when relationships benefit; no decorative charts. WCAG AA contrast; keyboard focus; labels for controls.
    36	
    37	Source must stay machine-readable after user edits:
    38	
    39	```html
    40	<body data-status="AWAITING_USER" data-review-id="...">
    41	  <article id="C1" data-kind="card-conflict">
    42	    <dd data-field="decision">TODO</dd>
    43	    <dd data-field="pattern-destroyer">false</dd>
    44	    <dd data-field="final-wording"></dd>
    45	    <dd data-field="notes"></dd>
    46	  </article>
    47	</body>
    48	```
    49	
    50	Rule IDs use `D*`/`R*`. Visible instructions: replace `TODO`, fill required text, change `data-status` to `READY`, save, say `continue`. Optional JS may aid filtering/progress; source values remain authority. Never rely only on browser state/localStorage.
    51	
    52	Name collisions → append `-2`, `-3`, … Never overwrite unfinished/completed review.
    53	
    54	## Repo contracts
    55	
    56	- Mutable source: `cards_mse/00_drafts/*/*.mse-set/`; folder, not zip.
    57	- Frozen: `02_alpha`, `04_beta`, `06_released`, generated aggregates. Never edit. Never create draft PDFs.
    58	- Manifest: `<project>.mse-set/set`; cards: `card <slug>` via `include_file:`.
    59	- General rules: `docs/rules/*`, `docs/keywords/*`, `docs/design/*`; indexes: `docs/RULES.md`, `docs/KEYWORDS.md`.
    60	- Archetype rules: numbered `CONTEXT.md`/`DESIGN.md`/`RULES.md`/`KEYWORDS.md`. Card values stay MSE-only.
    61	- Generators: `.script/`; prevent stale regeneration.
    62	- MSE config: gitignored `.env` via `launcher/mse_config.py`; never hardcode install path.
    63	- Source art: `original_images/<card_type>/`; imported MSE art: project `mse_images/`.
    64	- Preserve unrelated work. No reset/checkout/full-project regeneration. No backup/export/cache inside active `.mse-set`.
    65	
    66	## Phase 0 — Scope
    67	
    68	Run:
    69	
    70	```bash
    71	git status --short
    72	git diff --name-status -- cards_mse
    73	git diff -- cards_mse
    74	```
    75	
    76	Use user paths; else dirty/untracked mutable MSE paths. Classify manifest/card/art/generated files. Record exact scope + pre-edit diff. Read changed text fully with `utf-8-sig` semantics. Preserve BOM need. No direct MSE save identified → stop.
    77	
    78	## Phase 1 — Analyze
    79	
    80	Extract without rewrite: project/include, name, cost, frame/stylesheet, type/subtype, invocation/material, rules/labels, P/T, rarity/code, image refs, card add/remove/rename, new vocabulary/keyword/timing/zone/Summon rule.

    85	- image ref resolves in project;
    86	- removals leave no card/art orphan;
    87	- card/code totals match;
    88	- filenames/names match conventions.
    89	
    90	Facts only. No memory-based correction.
    91	
    92	## Phase 2 — Compare
    93	
    94	Read fully: relevant `docs/rules/*`, `docs/keywords/*`, index links, numbered project docs, 2–3 sibling cards, named generators, affected tests.
    95	
    96	Compare mechanics, timing, labels, Summon/material syntax, zones, vocabulary, type/frame, cost/stat conversion, English/PSCT, MSE structure, consumer assumptions.
    97	
    98	Create `C1…` ledger. Each item: MSE `path:line`, governing rule `path:line`, semantic delta, affected files, impact, options.
    99	
   100	Classification:
   101	
   102	- `RESTORE` → user error; restore documented value.
   103	- `ACCEPT` → preserve MSE card/archetype change.
   104	- `REVISE` → use required final wording/context.
   105	- `PATTERN_DESTROYER` flag → accepted syntax contradicts reusable rule.
   106

   119	## Phase 4 — Reconcile
   120	
   121	Apply approved `RESTORE`/`REVISE` changes plus `ADD_PERMISSION` clause. `ACCEPT`/`KEEP_RESTRICTIONS` preserve MSE text. Apply mechanical English, punctuation, capitalization, markup, labels, indentation, counts, refs. Any possible mechanic delta → new `C*`; return Phase 3.
   122	
   123	Sync consumers:
   124	
   125	- reusable archetype identity/mechanics/exceptions only; never duplicate card values/text;
   126	- manifest/include order, numbering/totals;
   127	- generators/updaters/batch lists/fixtures;
   128	- tests/indexes/xrefs;
   129	- source/imported art only when added/replaced/proven orphaned.

   132	
   133	## Phase 5 — Mine rules
   134	
   135	From reconciled cards + siblings, collect undocumented reusable patterns as `R1…`: new keyword/event, evolved global rule, repeated PSCT, frame/type/material mapping, grammar/zone convention.
   136	
   137	Exclude one-card mechanics, typos, documented rules, incomplete-card accidents.
   138	
   139	Each `R*`: evidence `path:line`, current rule, exact proposed wording, scope/boundary/exceptions, impacted files, side effects.
   140	
   141	## Phase 6 — Rule-proposals HTML gate
   142	
   143	No `D*`/`R*` → report `No general rule proposals.`; skip to Phase 7.
   144	
   145	Else generate one rule-proposals HTML per contract containing every item. Decisions: `ACCEPT`, `REJECT`, `REVISE`; `REVISE` requires final wording. Stop. Report path + counts/IDs.
   146	
   147	On `continue`, validate same file: `READY`; every decision exactly `ACCEPT|REJECT|REVISE`; revisions complete; evidence current. Invalid/incomplete → report IDs; stop. Stale → set `NEEDS_REVISION`; explain; stop.
   148

   150	
   151	```text
   152	Skill(skill="update-rules", args="review_file=.tmp/fix-mse-cards/<file>.html normalize=false apply_ready=true source=fix-mse-cards")
   153	```

Resume only after this result. Rescan MSE vs final rules; new conflict → Phase 3.
   156	
   157	## Phase 7 — Verify
   158	
   159	Run applicable checks:
   160	
   161	1. `python .script/lint_mse_card_style.py`;
   162	2. includes/cards/images/totals validation;
   163	3. relevant repo tests;

   168	8. expected PNG count; delete temp export/cache.

   170	Missing/invalid `.env` → tell user `python launcher/setup_mse.py`. Never guess MSE path. CLI export ≠ GUI Save compatibility; report manual Save/Save As when untested.
   171

   173	
   174	Report source MSE paths; card decisions; both HTML paths or skipped gates; final ADR path; accepted/revised/rejected rule IDs; mechanic-preserving fixes; synced docs/scripts/tests/assets; lint/test/export results; manual GUI check.
